reason: This is a test priority, not a performance prediction. K unrolling and the n=512 path are direct, low-scope attempts to reduce loop overhead while preserving accumulation order. A and B panel packing have plausible reuse benefits but add timed work; test the A-panel proposal before B because packing B and reusing it across row tiles may add more data movement without evidence that B access limits the consumer. The remaining scheduling, transpose, layout, and allocation proposals have less direct support. Prior trials were noisy or strongly regressed, so none establish causality or a gain for these distinct proposals.
